# Cyklická

> Czech-language educational guide to dietary supplements for women — vitamins,
> minerals, herbs, adaptogens and medicinal mushrooms. Organised by menstrual
> cycle phase, life stage and health topic. Nothing is sold on the site.

Cyklická explains what each nutrient does in the body, how strong the evidence
behind it is, how to dose it, what to combine it with and what to avoid. Every
supplement is presented from three angles: clinical research, contemporary
biohacking practice, and traditional folk use.

## Scope

- 70+ supplements: vitamins, minerals, amino acids, omega fatty acids,
  mitochondrial compounds, herbs, adaptogens and medicinal mushrooms
- Menstrual cycle: four phases, with cycle lengths from 26 to 33 days
- Life stages: adolescence, pre-conception, pregnancy, postpartum, adulthood,
  perimenopause, menopause
- Conditions: PCOS, endometriosis, thyroid disease, premature ovarian
  insufficiency, acne, PMS
- EU/EFSA upper limits and pregnancy safety flags on every entry

## Editorial position

- Educational only; explicitly not medical advice
- Evidence is graded, and weak or absent evidence is stated plainly rather
  than hidden — several entries say outright that the evidence is insufficient
- Commercial formulations are labelled as such and never presented as guidance
- Sources are listed with year, study design and participant numbers

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://cyklicka.cz/): search, life stages, health areas, cycle
- [Sources](https://cyklicka.cz/): named clinical trials and reviews, newest first
